_meta.purpose: Starter synthetic sample set for the PII Scrubber POC bake-off. ALL data is fictional. Ground-truth PII is labelled so recall/precision can be measured. Expand to ~50-100 for the full run.
_meta.note: SAP-specific IDs (CUSTOMER_NO, VENDOR_NO, USER_ID) are the categories a general PII model is most likely to miss — watch recall there.
